item.name: Activates Resource Plugin for compute instance identified by the instance ocid.

request.name: Activates Resource Plugin for compute instance identified by the instance ocid.

description.content:
Activates Resource Plugin for compute instance identified by the instance ocid.
Stores monitored instances Id and its state. Tries to enable Resource Monitoring plugin by making
remote calls to Oracle Cloud Agent and Management Agent Cloud Service.

info.name: Resource Discovery and Monitoring Control Appmgmt Control API

description.content: Use the Resource Discovery and Monitoring Control API to get details about monitored instances and perform actions. For more information, see [Resource Discovery and Monitoring](https://docs.oracle.com/iaas/os-management/osms/osms-resource-discovery-monitoring.htm).
